name: BSP_Ai_EntityRecordConstruct
evidence: Hypothesis, not a recovered symbol. Packet cc8_ai_target_weight_terms, read-only analysis. __thiscall(record, seven stack arguments), body 00A00020..00A0009B, the constructor 00A04560 calls at 00A046A5. Stores read by offset: 00A00038 record+0h from the first stack argument; 00A00040 and 00A0004A record+4h and +8h from the two floats of a pointer argument, the pose X and Z; 00A0005B record+0Ch from a byte argument; 00A0005E record+10h from the second stack argument; 00A0004D record+14h from a float argument; 00A00061 record+1Ch from a later one. 00A00058 COMISS against another float argument gates a second 00A371A0 interpolation whose destination was not traced. coverage: partial, and the gap is the ARGUMENT ORDER: 00A00031 PUSH ESI sits between the first three argument reads at 00A00020/00A00024/00A0002A and the rest at 00A00034/00A0003A/00A00046/00A00052, so the slots shift mid-body the way 00A0F810's do and need the same frame-walk treatment. Until it is settled the meanings of record+14h, +18h and +1Ch are not claimed. | Packet cc8_ai_target_weight_publish: the argument mapping is SETTLED with tools/frame_slot_census.py. 00A00020 needs no --pop and its seven reads fall on seven consecutive slots K=-4 through K=-28, which is arguments one to seven in order; 00A04560 needs four, one per RET 4 class test (--pop 00a04615=4 --pop 00a0462c=4 --pop 00a0465b=4 --pop 00a04672=4). Matching them against 00A04560's seven pushes backwards from 00A046A5: arg1 = ESI the class descriptor -> record+0h; arg2 = EDI which 00A04650 XOR'd to ZERO -> record+10h; arg3 = the float 00A0460F produced -> record+14h; arg4 = the SETNZ of 00A04568 CMP [entity+54h],2 -> record+1Ch; arg5 = the 00A045EA interpolation -> the 00A00058 COMISS test then record+18h, stored plain at 00A00091 or re-rolled through 00BD2F10 at 00A00083 when it is negative; arg6 = the immediate 1 -> record+0Ch as a byte; arg7 = the address of the pose pair -> record+4h and +8h. Two slot coincidences confirm it: 00A04597 (the pose X store) and 00A04688 (the LEA of arg7) both normalise to K=8, and 00A045EA and 00A04682 (the reload for arg5) both to K=20. Consequences: record+10h is ALWAYS ZERO, so the attacker_class key field 00A0F83C reads arrives at 00A08460 as zero from this path; record+14h is 009FDF30's class weight for entity+C4h times 00A04240(entity), so the class weight is natively the TARGET SCALE and not the inner weight; record+1Ch is the side being two or more, which is what 00A08460 receives as target_is_neutral.

name: BSP_AiCommand_IssueMoveToMember
evidence: Hypothesis, not a recovered symbol. Packet cc8_ai_command_tick, read-only analysis. __fastcall(Entity* member, const float* point), body 00A02020-00A02175 read in full. The single routine by which any AI command becomes a scene command. Class gate at 00A02026-00A02040: vtable[+5Ch](18h) admits a plane squadron only when 007EDA90 rejects it, otherwise vtable[+5Ch](6) admits a ship base. 00A02052 refreshes the pose through 00414DB0 when member+C8h is clear. 00A0205C-00A0206E compares the squared planar separation of member+FCh/+104h from the point against the dword at 00D21530, which is 00 00 00 00 in the image, so the test always passes. A ship is routed through 00417B10 at 00A020E8 with y forced to zero; anything else takes the point as given. The tail at 00A02136-00A0216A builds a position descriptor (kind 0, position_valid 1, object null) and calls 0077D600 with ECX the member, the class descriptor 00E08F68 (`moveto`, ordinal 15) and flags 1. docs/AI_COMMAND_TICK.md.

name: BSP_AiCapture_UnitArrivalValue
evidence: Hypothesis, not a recovered symbol. Packet cc2_ai_planner_tails, read-only analysis. __fastcall(ECX = Entity* unit, EDX = Entity* target), no stack arguments, RET, returns a float in ST0; body 00a03760-00a038b5. One unit's contribution to a capture target's value: the unit's Lua CaptureWeight (00A03510) in full inside target[+7A0h]'s radius, else a linear fade (1 - t/limit) with t = (dist - radius)/speed and limit = max(Capture_ArriveToRangeTime (tuning+198h), 1.0), zero when speed <= 0.1 or t >= limit. Speed comes from unit[+538h]+500h for IsType(6) and unit[+35Ch]+188h for IsType(18h). docs/AI_PLANNER_TAILS.md.

name: BSP_AiCommand_CandidateTargetWeight
evidence: Hypothesis, not a recovered symbol. Packet cc8_ai_close_attack_tick, read-only analysis. __fastcall(ECX = member entity, EDX = candidate entity) -> float in ST0. Its only caller is 00A13B60 at 00A146C4 and its callees are 00A08460 BSP_Ai_TargetWeight, 00923BE0 BSP_UnitInstance_GetHealth, 008DDF90 BSP_SzurkeNyil_ContainsUnit and 00A04560, so it is the target-weight model plus a health and world-set test. Body not read instruction by instruction; coverage partial. docs/AI_CLOSE_ATTACK_TICK.md. | Packet cc8_ai_target_weight, read-only analysis. Body 00A0F810..00A0F961 read in full. Two 00A04560 calls build a target record (EDI) and an attacker record (ESI); 00A0F843 calls 00A08460 with [ESI] the attacker, [ESI+10h] its class, [EDI] the target and [EDI+1Ch] the neutral flag. The rest is four multipliers, and its STACK SLOTS SHIFT across the two class tests' argument pushes: tools/stack_frame_walk.py 00a0f810 --indirect-pops 4 normalises them, and without that assumption every offset after 00A0F85B is four bytes out. Slot A (00A0F848 [ESP+10h] at depth 104) is the raw weight, zeroed at 00A0F864 when the attacker record's +1Ch is set and its vtable[+18h](1Ch) holds, consumed into the product at 00A0F897 and then REUSED as the class multiplier, seeded 1.0f at 00A0F8EE which is [ESP+14h] at depth 108, NOT the objective slot it resembles. Slot B (00A0F889) is attacker+18h * target+18h, reloaded and reused as the objective multiplier, 1.0f at 00A0F891 and 10.0f at 00A0F8C6 (00CE38B8) when 008DDF90 finds the target in objective set 0 or 4, chosen at 00A0F87E by comparing the local player's party with the attacker's +54h. Slot C (00A0F89E) is B * weight * target+14h. Slot D (00A0F8E6) is the double 2.0 at 00D7A308 minus 00923BE0(target). The class multiplier becomes 0.1f (00D7A2F0) when the target answers the 009FE0B0 trio IsKindOf 1Bh/45h/46h at 00A0F8F4/00A0F903/00A0F912, and 0.01f (00D228A0) instead when that trio target is not also IsKindOf(1Ch) at 00A0F92F, the same slot overwritten. The epilogue 00A0F943..00A0F956 returns B * C * D * A.

name: BSP_AiCommand_MemberPassInterval
evidence: Hypothesis, not a recovered symbol. Packet cc8_ai_command_object, read-only analysis. No Ghidra function; raw body 00A0FC50-00A0FC70 inclusive, RET 8. __thiscall(command)(float* hi, float* lo): MOVSS XMM0,[00CE3958] into [ESP+4] and MOVSS XMM0,[00CE3D34] into [ESP+8]. 00CE3958 = 00 00 00 40 = 2.0f, 00CE3D34 = 00 00 80 40 = 4.0f. name: BSP_AiCommand_NotifyEntityCommand_NoOp
evidence: Hypothesis, not a recovered symbol. Packet cc2_ai_group_think, read-only analysis. No Ghidra function; one byte pair at 00A0FC90 on disk, RET 8. The AI command base class's vtable slot +24h, which BSP_AiGroup_ForwardCommand (00A2BD90) tail-jumps to with (command, SceneCommandTarget*). It discards both arguments, so the group's entity-command notification does nothing in every class 00A2DFA0 installs (00D22990 at 00A2E11C/00A2E152 and 00D229E0 at 00A2E13B). 00A0FC90 occurs sixteen times in .rdata, all inside the AI-command vtable block 00D2298C-00D22C68. Packet cc8_ai_command_object: dumping 00D22968-00D22C68 as sixteen ten-dword rows puts this body at +24h in every one of the sixteen vtables without exception, so no class overrides it; the second caller is 00A2C790 at 00A2C83C, which reports each member's weapon-director state into the same sink. Settles docs/AI_GROUP_THINK.md section 2's open item. docs/AI_COMMAND_OBJECT.md.
